# Vanguard Digital Solutions

> One-person web design and software development studio in the UK, working
> with small businesses anywhere in the country. Work is handled by email or
> phone.

Vanguard Digital Solutions builds fast, accessible, mobile-first websites and
bespoke web applications for small businesses. Work spans small business
websites, online shops, booking and appointment systems, and custom web
applications. Every project is built to WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, UK GDPR
and PECR compliance, and Google Core Web Vitals performance targets. Clients'
domains are registered in their own name.

## Pages

- [Home](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/): services, starting prices, recent work and process overview.
- [Services](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/services): small business websites, online shops, booking systems, bespoke web applications, third-party integrations.
- [Online Shops](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/services/ecommerce): custom eCommerce with Stripe and PayPal checkout and stock control.
- [Booking Systems](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/services/booking-systems): online booking for salons, clinics and trades, with Booksy, Square and Google Calendar integration. From GBP 400.
- [Business Websites](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/services/business-website): information websites for professional services, trades and organisations. From GBP 100.
- [Bespoke Web Applications](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/services/bespoke-software): client portals, internal dashboards, workflow tools and system integrations.
- [Small Business Websites](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/small-business): what is included, what it costs, and how the process works for tradespeople, salons, consultants and small firms.
- [Pricing](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/pricing): starting prices for website packages and the optional monthly care plan.
- [Technology](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/technology): the stack and standards used (Vue, TypeScript, .NET, Microsoft Azure, WCAG 2.2 AA, UK GDPR, Core Web Vitals), plus a comparison with Wix, Squarespace and WordPress.
- [Process](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/process): the five-stage delivery process from enquiry to launch and handover, with typical timeframes.
- [Work](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/portfolio): case studies.
- [About](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/about): how the studio works with clients.
- [Contact](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/contact): enquiry form and contact email.

## Key facts

- Works with businesses across the UK. No walk-in premises and no published street address.
- Starter websites from GBP 100; websites with booking or payment integration from GBP 400; online shops and bespoke web applications are quoted individually. Optional care plan from GBP 35 per month. Not VAT registered.
- Typical delivery is 2 to 6 weeks from first contact to launch, depending on scope.
- Every enquiry gets a written reply within 24 hours.
- Contact: enquiries@vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk
